 Red Dead Redemption 2 won't be the biggest Rockstar open world game for much longer, since Grand Theft Auto VI will be released in just a few weeks on November 19. That said, the Wild West game is still thriving, and players still have a few days to grab a selection of in-game free downloads.

 From now until November 4, fans of Arthur Morgan and the 2018 Western epic he made a critical and financial success can enjoy limited-time-only content in Red Dead Redemption 2. For those who want to go on one last ride before GTA 6 comes out, this is the perfect opportunity.
 Red Dead Redemption 2 Free Downloads Are Available for a Few More Days
 Image via Rockstar Games 
 There are in-game events running from now until November 4 within the world of Red Dead Redemption 2 , though some of these events will be ending tomorrow. Specifically, this comes in the form of new content for Red Dead Online. There are new challenges to partake in, new items to collect, and a spooky atmosphere to enjoy, all for completely free.
 "Haunting season has reached the frontier, treating Red Dead Online players to hefty bonuses for the hair-raising adventures in Strange Tales of the West," the official background for the month's events reads on the Rockstar website . "Get 4X RDO$, Gold, and XP all month long for investigating these weird and unexplained phenomena that include shambling undead, ornery swamp folk, and reports of artificial life. And that's merely the beginning…"
 The All Hallows' Call to Arms will see players defending ten different seasonal maps from evil, including Van Horn and Bronte Mansion. Triple Rewards are being paid out to participants, and playing all ten maps before November 2 will net players the Benbow Jacket.

 Reaching Wave 5 on any map will get players the Rowberrow Outfit and the Air Banjo Emote, while reaching Wave 10 will earn them the Beat Chest Emote and a Gold Bar. Since this event is almost over, players who want to participate will need to act fast, but the rewards should be worth it. 
 "Investigate rumors of the terrifying and supernatural in Strange Tales of the West, four Telegram Missions paying out 4X RDO$, Gold, and XP through November 2," another potential mission for fans to engage with is described. "To get started, pick up author Theodore Levin’s letter from any Post Office or your Camp’s Lockbox and open it in your Satchel, or launch Telegram Missions from your Player Menu."
 Until November 4, Naturalists will also be able to receive an Irontooth Mask just by logging in, and they can earn a Best Shot Emote by sampling or hunting a Legendary Animal. While GTA VI will take center stage this month, it's likely that Rockstar will reveal even more free in-game content for RDR2 after this event ends.
